premises.text: Talented professionals are reduced to resumes in piles when job hunting
premises.evidence_span: when we go look for a job, we get reduced to this. Just another resume and a pile of paper

premises.text: Company-sponsored low-stakes competitions let tech professionals compete and stand out
premises.evidence_span: Competitions are sponsored by companies. They are low stakes

premises.text: Skills engine recommends, scores, and certifies abilities across many topics with badges
premises.evidence_span: Skills is the heart of Guild. This is what truly differentiates us. Based on everything I do on Guild, Guild is recommending skills that I may want to add to my repertoire

premises.text: Job recommendations and applications include skill-fit feedback and ranking odds
premises.evidence_span: Guild is telling me what are some key skills that are important for this job, and how am I doing against those

premises.text: Employers see ranked competitors/applicants from sponsored competitions and can invite passively
premises.evidence_span: I can go down and flip through every single person who participated, and they are ranked and how they performed

premises.text: Free for professionals; monetize by charging employers; no agencies
premises.evidence_span: Guild is free for professionals. We monetize by charging employers. And a really important point, Guild is a place for professionals and employers to connect directly. No third parties, no agencies on Guild
